definition: partly, with only one side done
description: A mirror selfie in a bright barber shop with a brick wall and colourful posters. A man in a black barber cape sits in the chair and holds up his phone, looking surprised: one side of his face is shaved clean with a little foam left, while the other side still has a full dark beard. Behind him a young woman barber with a high braided bun, a burgundy top and a black apron mixes shaving foam in a bowl, then picks up a razor and smiles. Hanging bulbs, red chairs and a plant fill the shop.
